photos.title: Streets of houses in Carolina Forest, NOAA aerial, January 2026
photos.what: Four streets of one- and two-story houses with gray roofs, short driveways and small back yards, with strips of pine and oak woods between the rows, in The Farm at Carolina Forest, seen from above at a slight angle on January 12, 2026. Lawns are brown in January. Cars are too small to read; no person can be recognized.
photos.caption: Houses in Carolina Forest, seen from above.
photos.alt: Rows of houses with gray roofs and short driveways along streets with strips of woods between them in Carolina Forest, seen from above
photos.author: NOAA National Geodetic Survey
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: NOAA National Geodetic Survey (NGS), Remote Sensing Division, Emergency Response Imagery, 2026 pre-event coastal collection, East Coast group EC2601a, flown 2026-01-12. One map tile, EC2601a_OB_N_C0785315w334545n.tif (4707 x 4707 px, WGS 84, 2.698e-6 degrees a pixel, top left -78.8875987, 33.7625987), the copy downloaded 2026-11-02 from the public S3 bucket noaa-eri-pds by the writer of /invest/run-the-numbers/. This frame is a different part of the tile from that page's photo (rows 1550-2750 against 2900-4100).

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer on 2026-11-02. The frame shows streets of houses in The Farm at Carolina Forest (inside Carolina Forest CDP and ZIP 29579). It does not show which houses are rented, so the caption says only that these are houses in Carolina Forest, one of the two places with the highest middle rent in the page's table. No person, plate, sign or house number is legible.

photos.title: The bell tower in Spadoni Park, Coastal Carolina University
photos.what: The Graham Family Bell Tower in Spadoni Park at Coastal Carolina University: a dark clock and bell cupola on a red brick base with arches, at the right; a crape myrtle in pink bloom, pines and a bed of red flowers at the left; a paved walk and a campus building with tall windows behind. Summer. No person can be seen.
photos.caption: The bell tower in Spadoni Park, at Coastal Carolina University in Conway.
photos.alt: A clock and bell tower on a red brick base beside a pink crape myrtle and flower beds on the Coastal Carolina University campus
